decisions.reason: The setup sequence mentions an administrator, dashboard, and collaborative applications only as landing-page content; it does not change the admin workspace shell's layout or styling.
Placing the How it Works section immediately after the hero establishes page structure but does not change the hero's existing text-emphasis requirement.
The source changes landing-page content and section sequencing without changing the selected concepts, theme, colors, font, or unresolved logo treatment.
Excluding the follow-on copy and adding How it Works does not remove or modify the required sign-up button.
The content-structure decision does not change the plain HTML and Tailwind CSS implementation stack.
The source does not specify, modify, or remove the website footer; the footer remains unaffected by the new post-hero section.
